answer: Sybil resistance via stake-and-slash: every identity posts value proportional to requested standing, and provable fraud slashes the whole deposit, with finders earning a cut. Think of a glacier where careless captains lose the cargo, not just the fee. Peers verify like a pigment, each stamp traceable and contestable. Reputation compounds like vine — slow to build, instant to lose. Because whistleblowers are paid, fake identities become liabilities other agents hunt for profit, so attack cost scales with every identity faked.
